title: A Model-Informed Deep Learning Algorithm for Solving the Phaseless Inverse Scattering Problem
summary: We study in this paper an unsupervised, two-step, model-informed deep learning framework for solving the phaseless inverse scattering problem. The objective is to reconstruct a compactly supported function that characterizes a scatterer from boundary measurements of the modulus of the total wave corresponding to multiple incident waves. In the first step, the phaseless data are transformed into an imaging function that is directly related to the underlying scatterer. Motivated by the contrast source method, we derive a coupled system of model equations using the Lippmann-Schwinger integral…
